historicalCoverage: Coverage is uneven because some faculty maintain deep news archives and others publish little news or have inaccessible/dead pages. Empty searches are not evidence that a person has no achievements.

sourceLinkCheck.note: Direct checks found no 404 story links. Access blocks and the two transient request failures were covered by the primary-page web-tool reviews. Institutional bot protection can differ by client.
